findings.note: Closes the one open CROSS-FILE GAPS line of family instruments-7 (work/.b037-report-instruments-7.txt, surfaced by the CONFIRMED finding otherworldly-protection#computed-value). 23 records - the 21 armor-innovation modifications plus the two innovation armour items - carried aonParentId "innovation-5", the 2021 Guns & Gears printing, while every one of them encodes the 2025 remastered printing innovation-1 (void/vitality/spirit/holy/unholy, the +5 power suit, the vitality/void energy barrier). aonParentId is provenance only - grep finds no reader in src/ beyond one comment - so no built character changes and no test can pin it; the cost of leaving it is that the next prose fill or verification pass reads these records against the wrong printing, which is exactly how the legacy alignment-damage wording would land on top of our remastered resistances. Precedent for the shape: the existing overlay row classFeatures/blessed-swiftness.aonParentId = class-feature-877, which survives a regen (stamp-aonid.mjs clears aon* fields, the overlay is re-applied after it) and still holds in shipped core.json. The identical stale pointer on the 21 WEAPON-innovation modifications (aonParentId innovation-7, the 2021 Weapon printing, whose remaster is innovation-3) is NOT authored here - it is outside this gap line's records; see the report.

Value matches its twenty sibling modifications and both innovation items byte for byte ({book: "Pathfinder Guns & Gears", license: "ORC"}), so only the license changes. No existing overlay row for this field on this record, so no supersedes.
